about: A file attached to a message or waiting to be sent: a media square with the type's icon, a thumbnail or a spinner, the name and a line of detail, and the actions. A group lists several, stacked as rows or wrapped as tiles.
label: Attachments

orientation.about: `horizontal` renders a row: the media square, the name over the detail, and the actions at the end. `vertical` renders a tile with the media across the top and the actions over its corner. A group stacks rows and wraps tiles.
orientation.title: Rows and tiles

photosScene.about: Tiles under a message, the group small and vertical. Each thumbnail has an empty `alt`, because the name under it already names the file.
photosScene.title: Photos in a message

size.about: The size sets the media square, the padding, the gap and the text styles. A group states the size of every attachment in it.
size.title: Sizes

states.about: `idle` dashes the edge of a file not yet sent, and `error` inks the edge, the media and the detail in the error palette. A spinner in the media square shows a file on its way. The detail states each state in words, because a screen reader reads no edge or ink.
states.title: States

title: Attachment
